jobs_results.description:
Quantitative Consulting Center Statistician/ Data Scientist

OVERVIEW

Biola University seeks a Statistical / Data Science Consultant to support the University’s

statistical consulting activities. This position combines hands-on statistical and data-science

consulting with client development and project coordination in an educational setting. Approximately half of the position will involve direct work on consulting projects, including statistical analysis, data management, interpretation, and communication of results. The remaining portion will involve developing consulting opportunities, communicating with prospective and current clients, coordinating multiple projects, and maintaining efficient workflows from initial inquiry through project completion. The successful candidate will be a strong applied-statistics generalist who enjoys working

directly with clients, can translate research and organizational questions into appropriate

quantitative analyses, and is comfortable taking initiative to develop new consulting

relationships. The position requires broad competence in standard graduate-level applied

statistics, sound statistical judgment, and the ability to learn new methods or seek additional

expertise when projects require unusually specialized techniques. This is primarily an individual-contributor position and does not include regular staff-management responsibilities, although the position may provide technical direction to student research assistants.

 Alignment with Theological PositionsAlignment with Theological Positions: The person who fills this position must be someone who personally agrees with Biola’s Articles of Faith and Statement of Biblical Principles and who is supportive of the positions taken by Biola as contained in its Eschatology Teaching Position. As such, this person may not speak against or act in a manner inconsistent with these positions during the course of their employment at Biola. DepartmentQuantitative Consulting Center, www.biola.edu/qcc  SupervisorDirector, Quantitative Consulting Center

 Educational RequirementsMaster’s degree in statistics, biostatistics, data science, applied mathematics,

quantitative social science, or a closely related field.

Strong Proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis, data management, and visualization.

Work RequirementsExempt, full time or part time position

This position requires personal attendance at Biola’s campus in La Mirada, California, but will consider a limited hybrid/flexible work arrangement

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Statistical and Data Science ConsultingConsult with clients to clarify research questions, understand study designs and data structures, and develop appropriate analysis plans.

Conduct statistical analyses for a variety of applied research and consulting projects.

Clean, organize, merge, validate, and document quantitative datasets.

Apply a broad range of standard graduate-level statistical methods appropriate to applied research, including regression, analysis of variance, categorical data analysis, multivariate methods, experimental and quasi-experimental design, survey analysis, power analysis, and related methods.

Select statistical methods based on the research question, study design, characteristics of the data, and assumptions of the proposed analysis.

Recognize when a project requires methodological expertise beyond the position’s current experience and appropriately learn, consult, or escalate specialized statistical issues as needed.

Evaluate model assumptions, data quality, uncertainty, and limitations of statistical conclusions.

Produce clear tables, visualizations, technical summaries, and reports.

Explain statistical methods and results accurately to clients with differing levels of quantitative expertise.

Assist clients in translating statistical findings into appropriate conclusions for research reports, presentations, publications, and organizational decision-making.

Develop reproducible and well-documented analytical workflows.

Learn unfamiliar statistical techniques and substantive research areas as needed to address new consulting problems.




Client Development and Project Coordination

Identify potential consulting clients and opportunities consistent with the University’s educational mission.

Initiate contact with prospective clients through telephone, email, professional networks, referrals, and other appropriate outreach.

Meet with prospective clients to understand their needs and determine whether and how the consulting program can assist them.

Develop project scopes, anticipated deliverables, timelines, and estimates of the resources required for proposed projects.

Maintain relationships with current and previous clients and identify opportunities for additional appropriate consulting work.

Coordinate multiple concurrent consulting projects and maintain accurate records of project status, deadlines, deliverables, client communications, and follow-up needs.

Monitor projects from initial inquiry through completion and help ensure that commitments to clients are met.

Coordinate scheduling and communication among clients, consultants, and student research assistants as appropriate.

Assist with proposal development and other activities associated with establishing new consulting engagements.

Contribute to the ongoing development and effectiveness of the University’s statistical consulting activities.




Student Research Assistants

Provide technical direction and appropriate project assignments to student research assistants when utilized.

Review student analytical work for accuracy and quality.

Required Skills/QualificationsStrong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and client relationships simultaneously.

Ability and willingness to initiate contact with prospective clients and participate actively in developing new consulting opportunities.

Ability to work independently, exercise professional judgment, and take responsibility for projects from initial consultation through final delivery.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Demonstrated ability to independently conduct statistical analyses using real-world data.

Ability to interpret statistical results accurately and communicate their practical meaning to non-specialists.

Ability to recognize when specialized expertise is required and to learn new methods or seek additional consultation as appropriate.

Experience preparing, cleaning, restructuring, and integrating datasets for analysis.

Ability to determine appropriate statistical methods rather than simply implement analyses specified by others.

Ability to evaluate statistical assumptions, identify potential methodological problems, and recommend appropriate alternatives.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications

Experience providing statistical consulting or collaborative research support.

Experience working directly with multiple clients, investigators, faculty members, or organizational stakeholders.

Experience with predictive modeling, machine learning, or other modern data-science methods.

Experience with research design, measurement, survey methodology, or program evaluation.

Experience preparing analyses for peer-reviewed research, grant-funded projects, institutional research, or other professional settings.

Experience developing new client relationships, consulting engagements, or externally funded analytical work.

Experience supervising or mentoring student researchers or junior analysts.

Familiarity with reproducible research practices, version control, or collaborative analytical workflows.

 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

The successful candidate should be able to:

Work collaboratively in an academic environment while functioning independently on assigned responsibilities.

Serve as a statistical generalist across a wide range of applied research questions.

Learn unfamiliar substantive areas sufficiently to understand a client’s research or organizational problem.

Take initiative in identifying opportunities for new consulting relationships.

Move comfortably between statistical principles and practical applied analysis.

Recognize when a proposed analysis is inappropriate and recommend a better approach.

Learn new statistical methods efficiently when a project requires techniques outside the candidate’s previous experience.

Recognize when specialized methodological expertise should be sought rather than attempting to work beyond appropriate limits.

Balance statistical rigor with the practical constraints of consulting projects.

Work effectively on several projects at different stages of development.

Communicate professionally and confidently with prospective and current clients.

Hours: Monday-Friday, standard business hours (PST)
Position Overview:
We are seeking a Data Reporting and Analytics Consultant to support clinical research initiatives focused on vaccines and infectious diseases. In this role, you will work with clinical research data to develop and maintain analytical programs, generate reports, and support research teams in answering important healthcare questions.


This is an excellent opportunity for an early- to mid-career professional with a background in biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, data science, or a related field who enjoys combining programming and analytical skills with meaningful healthcare research.


You will collaborate with experienced researchers and analysts, contribute to ongoing research projects, and help ensure that data and analytical results are accurate, reliable, and useful for research decision-making.


Key Responsibilities:

Develop, maintain, and update analytical programs and reports supporting clinical research projects.
Use SQL and R or Python to access, analyze, manipulate, and interpret research data.
Apply statistical and analytical methods to support vaccine, infectious disease, and other healthcare research initiatives.
Evaluate data and analytical results to identify inconsistencies, investigate unexpected findings, and ensure results make sense in the context of the research question.
Collaborate with biostatisticians, epidemiologists, researchers, and other project team members to understand research objectives and deliver accurate, meaningful analyses.
Support ongoing projects funded by pharmaceutical partners and government research organizations.
Document analytical processes, communicate findings, and contribute to the development and maintenance of research programs.
Manage assigned projects and competing priorities while meeting deadlines and maintaining high-quality work.
Participate in onboarding and training, incorporate feedback, and continue developing technical and research expertise.
Communicate proactively with team members, ask questions when challenges arise, and work independently in a remote environment.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, data science, or a related field. A relevant master's degree is preferred.
Proficiency in R or Python.
Strong SQL skills and the ability to work with research or healthcare datasets.
Experience or academic training in healthcare research, epidemiology, biostatistics, or a related research discipline.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate data quality and determine whether results are reasonable.
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and seek guidance when needed.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree in biostatistics, public health, epidemiology, data science, or a related field.
Experience with SAS, particularly in a research or healthcare environment.
Familiarity with Databricks, Posit Workbench, or similar analytical platforms.
Experience supporting clinical research, epidemiological studies, vaccine research, or infectious disease research.
Experience working with healthcare claims data or other clinical and healthcare datasets.
Experience contributing to research manuscripts, publications, or scientific projects.
Familiarity with pharmaceutical-sponsored research or projects funded by government agencies.

Work Environment and Schedule:

Fully remote position.
Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States for contract work, but must work PST hours.
Candidates must reside in California to be eligible for potential conversion to an employee of the organization.
The role requires self-direction, strong communication, and the ability to work productively with limited day-to-day supervision.
Initial onboarding and training will be provided, with an expectation that team members will progressively work independently.

This position may begin as a contract opportunity, with the potential for conversion to a longer-term employee position based on performance, business needs, and available funding. Conversion is not guaranteed.


The team supports an ongoing pipeline of clinical research projects funded by pharmaceutical companies and government organizations, creating opportunities to contribute to meaningful research over time.

jobs_results.job_title: Managing Consultant - Life Sciences Data & Analytics
jobs_results.description: Job Family: Strategy & Transformation Consulting Travel Required: Up to 10% Clearance Required: None What You Will Do: We are looking for a Managing Consultant to join our Life Sciences team, which supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies with commercial insights and strategy as well as data and business analytics. This role will be a primary member of our Life Science advisory team, and collaborate closely with our firmwide Data, Advanced Analytics, and Technology Transformation teams to shape the growth of our Life Science data services offerings. Candidates should be market-facing self-starters who take ownership of their work, are enthusiastic, and have a collaborative mindset to support our efforts to sell and provide consulting solutions. You will coordinate activities across multiple projects and provide experience-based insight across strategy, commercial analytics, and data-driven solution design. As a Life Science Managing Consultant, you will: Translate client's key business questions and structuring/executing comprehensive analytics plans to provide necessary insights (e.g., cross-sectional analyses, longitudinal studies, inferential statistics, and structured decision support). Convey and summarize detailed data insights through a strategic lens that is understandable and actionable by cross-functional internal/external stakeholders. Leverage various commercial and real-world evidence datasets to drive insights that address client business problems, which include but are not limited to medical and pharmacy claims (open and closed), formulary and managed care data, and EMR data. Utilize datasets across multiple third-party data vendors, which include but are not limited to IQVIA, Komodo, Compile, MMIT/Norstella, Symphony Health, Truven/Merative, and Definitive Healthcare. Lead internal and external discussions to understand and generate project requirements, scope, and develop client-tailored analytical solutions. Shape data-driven engagements by serving as an intermediary between data scientists and clients. Understand and analyze client business challenges and match them to firm and/or third-party data and analytic capabilities. Work with strategy consulting teams and data science teams to design and execute data-driven projects, such as market sizing/segmentation, patient journey, provider profiling/targeting, provider affiliation mapping, epidemiology studies, managed care analytics, pull-through modeling/program design, forecasting, field force design, KPI/performance tracking, and incentive comp. Help design and lead the development of new solutions/services firmwide. Apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to translate business requirements into technology solutions. Provide support across multiple client engagements; develop presentations, briefings, memos, and reports. Should be able to work independently but with oversight from management. Prioritize and handle multiple tasks, research, and analyze pertinent client, industry and technical matters, utilize problem-solving skills, and communicate effectively in written and verbal formats to various audiences (including multiple levels of management and external clients) in a professional business environment. Experience in managing independent as well as integrated project modules including ownership of workstreams and coaching/mentoring others. Present proposals and deliverables during meetings, summits, and working sessions with senior client executives. Support managing contract budgets, developing and sharing best practices, and evolving Guidehouse’s data and analytics capabilities. What You Will Need: Bachelor's Degree; FOUR (4) years of additional professional experience in lieu of Bachelor's FOUR (4+) years of Life Sciences industry, management consulting, and/or data vendor experience is required, plus advanced degree MBA, PhD, PharmD or MD. Experience in commercial management consulting functions such as portfolio and asset strategy, data/commercial analytics, launch excellence & brand planning, patient services and market access is a plus. Must possess strong analytical skills (Excel, Access, etc.) and leverage analytic techniques to use data to guide client and team decision-making. Must have advanced data collection, research, and information-finding experience and explore solutions that challenge critical thinking. 3+ years of experience in business & data analytics. Experience with sophisticated drug forecasting techniques. Must be willing to travel to client sites across the US up to 20% of the time. Authorized to work for any US employer without sponsorship. What Would Be Nice To Have: Advanced degree, MBA, Information Systems, Healthcare Management, Innovation and entrepreneurship, or similar quantitative discipline. In-line and pipeline forecasting and NPV modeling. Technical/product management and software experience. Experience with common analytic toolsets such as SQL, R, Python, Snowflake. Proficiency in data visualization services such as PowerBI, Tableau. Ability to build client-ready forecast models/ financial models. Ability to work with large data sets such as claims data. Who We Are



Founded in 1994, Surveying And Mapping, LLC (SAM) is a nationwide leader in geospatial and construction-phase solutions. With more than 50 offices and 1,600 professionals, we deliver the scale, technology, and expertise needed to support projects of any size. SAM streamlines project delivery through a single, coordinated team, offering in-house capabilities across land surveying, aerial mapping, subsurface utility engineering (SUE), utility coordination (UC), GIS, BIM, and construction engineering inspection (CEI).

 

By combining advanced technology, digital workflows, and decades of experience, we provide accurate, actionable data that helps clients move critical infrastructure projects forward with confidence. At SAM, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, growth, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the built environment.

 
Your Impact at SAM

SAM's Digital & Data Services group helps electric utilities turn complex infrastructure data into trusted, governed, and interoperable network models. We advise transmission and distribution utilities on how to manage their electrical network models across the full lifecycle—planned, designed, as-built, as-operated, and retired—and how to evolve from fragile, point-to-point model exchanges to governed model flows across GIS, asset management, planning, protection, and operations systems.

We are looking for a mid-level consultant to join SAM’s Digital and Data Services division, with a primary goal of contributing to our Network Model Management (NMM) practice ideally in the areas of electric and gas utility industry. You will support client-facing engagements that include current-state assessments, target-state architecture, data governance design, integration delivery, and roadmap execution. You will work alongside senior architects and utility subject-matter experts to deliver practical, high-value outcomes for clients modernizing their grid data foundations.

This is a consulting role. You will contribute directly to the kinds of projects our team delivers today: network model management maturity assessments, vendor selection and RFP support, canonical data modeling, validation and quality-gate design, and integration flows connecting systems such as ESRI Utility Network, Work and Asset Management, EMS, ADMS, DERMS, Network Planning, and SCADA platforms.

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
 
 
 
  At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

    The Senior Data Consultant is an experienced consulting professional responsible for leading the successful delivery of complex data, analytics, AI, and cloud transformation engagements while serving as a trusted advisor to clients. The role combines consulting excellence, business acumen, technical expertise, delivery leadership, and people development to deliver measurable business outcomes and strengthen long-term client partnerships.

 Responsibilities

   Build trusted advisor relationships with business, technology, and executive stakeholders.

   Support recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
 
 Expectations
 
  Senior Data Consultants are expected to consistently demonstrate leadership, accountability, consulting excellence, technical expertise, and business acumen while delivering exceptional client outcomes.


   Leadership and Ownership


  
   Take ownership of delivery outcomes and remain accountable for quality, financial performance, and client success.
   Lead teams with integrity, professionalism, and a collaborative leadership style.
   Demonstrate initiative by proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving execution.
   Coach and develop team members through mentoring and constructive feedback.

   Balance business priorities, scope, schedule, cost, quality, and technical considerations.
   Build trusted advisor relationships through credibility, proactive communication, and executive presence.
  
  Technical Excellence and Practice Leadership


  
   Design practical, scalable, and business-aligned solutions that meet client objectives.
   Produce high-quality, executive-ready deliverables that reflect AHEAD consulting standards.
   Contribute to practice growth through mentoring, innovation, reusable assets, business development, and continuous learning.
   Represent AHEAD with professionalism while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  Required

 Preferred

  Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or similar technologies.
